plan.explanation: Face milling of datum F1 is performed first on M3. Hole sequences (F2, F3, F6, F9) and threaded hole (F7) follow the drill-ream or drill-tap logic with precedence enforced between drilling and finishing operations. Chamfers F4/F8 are executed on M1 after datum setup. Pockets F5/F11 are milled on M3.
assumptions: Tool T1 (drill) is reused for all hole spot_drilling and drilling steps due to lack of specific diameter mapping in resources; this is a simplification.
Machine M3 is used for all hole operations and face/pocket milling despite M2 having drilling capability, to minimize machine switching and adhere to a single mill strategy for holes.
uncertainties: Actual tool diameters for T1 are not specified; compatibility with the required hole sizes (5mm, 8mm, 10mm, 12mm) is assumed valid.
No collision checks were performed between tools and features.
